scope: The standing exterior of Tytuvėnai Monastery North Wall and Gate. Curved brick and fieldstone perimeter wall, a pitched coping, a double gate with paired pilasters and shallow pediment, and a single west wicket.
geometryBasis: The national heritage record locates the gate north of the livestock barn. The register describes the wall joining the northwest chapel to the barns. The exact masonry alignment between those controls is estimated.
